deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: Matches the prevent-destructive-loss archetype: a generic platform policy can require this be set to 'PREVENT' so a security-enforcing profile group cannot be accidentally destroyed via terraform apply/destroy.

description.description: An optional description of the profile. The Max length is 512 characters.
description.rationale: Cosmetic free-text field with no bearing on enforcement.

labels.description:
A map of key/value label pairs to assign to the resource.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Organisational metadata for filtering/billing; does not affect enforcement.

location.description:
The location of the security profile group.
The default value is 'global'.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

name.description: The name of the security profile group resource.
name.rationale: Identifier only; naming has no security bearing.

parent.description:
The name of the parent this security profile group belongs to.
Format: 'organizations/{organization_id}' or 'projects/{project_id}'.
parent.rationale: Identifies which org/project owns the resource. A generic platform policy cannot constrain this without hardcoding a specific organisation or project ID, which is team-specific and out of scope.
